raw_translation: Viwango vilivyoonyeshwa hutumika tu kwa mwaka wa mapato ya Australia wa ZXQPH0000QXZ–ZXQPH0001QXZ (ZXQPH0002QXZ Julai ZXQPH0003QXZ hadi ZXQPH0004QXZ Juni ZXQPH0005QXZ). Kodi ya Medicare na surcharge, punguzo, offsets, malipo ya HELP, kutozwa, mapato maalum na kesi ngumu za makazi hazijumuishwi. Hakikisha hali yako na Ofisi ya Ushuru wa Australia. Calculator inazima baada ya mwaka wa kodi kumalizika hadi viwango vyake vitakavyoangaliwa.
source: Rates shown apply only to the 2026–27 Australian income year (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027). Medicare levy and surcharge, deductions, offsets, HELP repayments, withholding, special income and complex residency cases are excluded. Confirm your circumstances with the Australian Taxation Office. The calculator disables itself after the tax year ends until its rates are reviewed.
translation: Viwango vilivyoonyeshwa hutumika tu kwa mwaka wa mapato ya Australia wa 2026–27 (1 Julai 2026 hadi 30 Juni 2027). Kodi ya Medicare na surcharge, punguzo, offsets, malipo ya HELP, kutozwa, mapato maalum na kesi ngumu za makazi hazijumuishwi. Hakikisha hali yako na Ofisi ya Ushuru wa Australia. Calculator inazima baada ya mwaka wa kodi kumalizika hadi viwango vyake vitakavyoangaliwa.

raw_translation: Kuingia jumla ya kupanda, kuchagua idadi kamili ya risers na kuingia moja tread kina. Hii moja kwa moja ndege makadirio hutumia moja chini ya tread kuliko risers.
source: Enter the total rise, choose a whole number of risers and enter one tread depth. This straight-flight estimate uses one fewer tread than risers.
translation: Kuingia jumla ya kupanda, kuchagua idadi kamili ya risers na kuingia moja tread kina. Hii moja kwa moja ndege makadirio hutumia moja chini ya tread kuliko risers.
